meaning: A private message that only the person you send it to can see, sent on a social media site.
clues: It is a way to send a message through a social media app.
Only the person you send it to can see it.
It is separate from words shown to everyone who follows you.
People use it to share details they would not post for everyone to see.
Its short name uses two letters.
assumes: A post is a message shared on a social platform
A comment is a reply attached to a post or video
A tag marks or names an account in a post or photo

decoys.meaning: A message, photo, or video that you share on a social platform for others to see.
A reply written below a post, photo, or video on a social platform.
A link to someone's profile that you add to a photo or comment.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try sending a private note to someone you know on a social app. Check the name before you tap send.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A private note still deserves care. We checked the address before sealing a letter.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If a message asks for a code or money, pause and check with the person another way.

sources.name: Computer Hope, Facebook posts and comments

why: It is private, but check the name before you send.

situations.text: A DM asks you for a code or money. Is it fine to send it right away?
situations.why: If a message asks for a code or money, pause and check with the person another way first.
